learning_outcomes.text: Use basic numeric and algebraic manipulations in the solution of engineering problems.
Use basic mathematical functions including trigonometric, exponential and logarithmic functions in the solution of engineering.
Use basic complex numbers in the solution of engineering problems.
Use and apply mathematical software to the solution of engineering mathematics problems.

syllabus_topics: Introduction of the use of a computer algebra system (for example MATLAB or similar).
Use of the software applied to the syllabus items below.
Revision of basic algebraic techniques: Substitution, simplification, factorisation, indices, evaluation and transposition of formulae, fractions and partial fractions.
Linear and quadratic equations, linear simultaneous equations.
Functions: Notation, types of function, composite and inverse, graphs.
Trigonometric functions and their graphs, simple trigonometric identities and equations.
Engineering waves in mechanical and electrical problems.
Natural logarithm as inverse of exponential function, graph and properties.
Definitions and calculation of hyperbolic functions including inverse functions.
Complex numbers: Complex arithmetic, complex conjugate, Argand diagram.
Very basic treatment of Euler's formula.
assessment_rules: Students will complete regular online tests to monitor their engagement and progress.
institution: Liverpool John Moores University — BEng (Hons) Electrical and Electronic Engineering
